After the panic finally hit, I step away from the apple red KitchenAid blender I was musing over. Walking with purpose I find my way towards the nearest holy place to pray at, also know as the restrooms. Warframe is pretty good, 3rd person shooter with a lot of mechanics and choices.

With all F2P games there are in-game and store currencies. Warframe's in-game currency is Credits and the store currency is Platinum. If you know what you're doing and have some pretty good RNG luck on your side you could spend absolutely zero dollars on this game since loot you get from enemies/missions you can trade to other players for Platinum. The Platinum can be traded for extra character and weapon slots.

Warframe also has a great community behind it and the company is full of pretty cool people. Highly recommend it.

Even if it's still in early access, Robocraft looks promising
